name: Format and mechanically modify provided texts
description: Users asked to format, structure, or mechanically modify provided texts by applying specific typesetting rules, such as adjusting capitalization, punctuation, spacing, diacritics, or paragraph breaks. Requests also included converting text to specific styles (e.g., uppercase, past tense, phonetic spelling), inserting pauses for voiceovers, or removing specific elements like verse numbers or diacritics, often while preserving the original wording.
